orchestration: workload-major, pair-major, tree-minor; the leading tree alternates per pair (even pairs lead old, odd pairs lead new), so consecutive forks always run on different trees and each native pin leads equally
hostrec: hostrec.sh pre/post appends per fork in ../../wp4-scratch/sessions/wp4-observed-cache-2/hostrec/host.log (one line per record); the 60 s polling loop is the session wrapper's job, and the wrapper copies its host log into the session directory as hostrec.log; failed or timed-out hostrec calls are listed in hostrec_failures
